title: How Adam Robinson would take a SaaS from 0 to 1,000+ customers: discovery, manual MVP, then the magic triangle
summary: Adam lays out his zero-to-1,000-customers system from building RB2B and two other software companies. Validate with 50+ discovery calls and prepayment, ship a manual MVP, prove product market fit with three signals, then run content, outreach and retargeting together as a "magic triangle".

principles.text: Do at least 50 discovery calls and look for prepayment before writing any code.
principles.quote: Before writing a single line of code, commit to 50 discovery calls minimum. Your only goal is to find people who will pay you for something that you haven't built yet.
